audit.why: Early Naafiri-favored, flips to Talon at 6/first item — matches 53.8% WR over 2130 games and both chart sources.
Spikes (her 3-5 window, your 6, first item, late) present and consistent across layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly calls Naafiri's W 'Hounds' Pursuit' and a dash — W is The Call of the Pack (untargetable/empower, 26s) and her lane dash is E Eviscerate (11s); Hounds' Pursuit is her R (110/95/80s). Talon's R misnamed 'Shadow Assassin' in two places. Cooldowns field had no digits. Full chart said Skill x7 against content/packet Naafiri x4 then Talon x3.
audit.why: Kit file is authoritative on slots, names and cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Names and slots fixed, real cooldowns added, chart layers aligned with rewritten whys, pronouns corrected.

edits.before: The first levels belong to Naafiri, not you. edits.before: Levels 3-5 stay hers: if you commit a full combo into stacked packmates you lose the trade, so play for farm and safety instead of forcing the all-in. Shove and roam on your ultimate rather than banging your head on the losing duel.
